decisions.quote: As in phase 1, although at a descriptive level the causal explanation condition was somewhat more effective than the denial condition in preventing misconceptions from taking root, in the final sample this replication of the claim was unsuccessful according to the SCORE criteria.
decisions.location: Short statement of results / Replication Result
decisions.reason: The replication report explicitly states that the replication of the claim from Nyhan and Reifler (2015) was unsuccessful in both stage 1 and the combined final sample.
